entries.question: which all documents are required during admission in mbbs
entries.answer:
Okay, to help you with the list of documents required for MBBS admission at KGMU (King George's Medical University), I need to provide a general list. **Please note that the exact requirements can vary slightly depending on the year and specific admission policies. It's crucial to always check the official KGMU website or admission brochure for the most up-to-date and accurate information.**

However, here's a comprehensive list of documents that are generally required for MBBS admission, along with some important considerations:

**Essential Documents (Generally Required):**

*   **NEET (UG) Admit Card:** The admit card you received for the NEET (UG) exam.
*   **NEET (UG) Score Card/Result:** The official score card showing your NEET (UG) scores.
*   **Class 10th Marksheet and Certificate:**  Marksheet and certificate as proof of date of birth and for verifying your name.
*   **Class 12th Marksheet and Certificate:**  Marksheet and certificate with the required subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English).
*   **Transfer Certificate (TC) / School Leaving Certificate (SLC):** From your last attended school/institution.
*   **Character Certificate:** From the last school/institution attended.
*   **Domicile Certificate/Residence Proof:**  This is to prove that you belong to the state/region as per the admission requirements. (This is very important for state-quota seats).
*   **Category Certificate (if applicable):**
    *   **OBC-NCL Certificate:**  For Other Backward Classes - Non-Creamy Layer candidates.
    *   **SC/ST Certificate:** For Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe candidates.
    *   **EWS Certificate:** For Economically Weaker Section candidates. (This is only applicable if you fall under this category).
*   **Passport-size Photographs:**  Usually several recent passport-size photographs are required. The exact number will be mentioned in the official notification.
*   **Adhaar Card:** Proof of identity.
*   **Medical Fitness Certificate:**  A certificate from a registered medical practitioner stating that you are medically fit to pursue MBBS.
*   **Migration Certificate:** Required if you are from a board other than UP Board (Generally).

**Additional Documents (May be required, check the official notification):**

*   **Gap Certificate (if applicable):** If there is a gap year/years between your Class 12th and admission year, you might need to provide a gap certificate explaining the reason for the gap.
*   **Undertaking/Affidavit (as per the format provided by KGMU):** This may be required for various purposes, such as confirming the information provided or agreeing to abide by the rules of the university.
*   **Other Certificates:** Any other certificates mentioned in the official admission notification (e.g., for sports quota, physically challenged, etc.).
*   **Caste Certificate:** If you are from a reserved category, you will need to submit the relevant caste certificate.

**Important Considerations & Tips:**

*   **Original Documents & Photocopies:** You will need to bring both the original documents and a set of self-attested photocopies of all the documents.
*   **Self-Attestation:** Make sure to self-attest (sign and date) all the photocopies.
*   **Read the Official Notification Carefully:** The official admission notification from KGMU will be the most accurate source of information. Read it thoroughly to understand the specific requirements and formats.
*   **Keep Copies:** Make extra copies of all your documents for your records.
*   **Arrange Documents in Order:** Organize your documents in the order specified in the admission notification for easier verification.
*   **Reach Out to KGMU:** If you have any doubts or questions, don't hesitate to contact the KGMU admission office directly. Their contact information will be available on the official website.
*   **Stay Updated:** Regularly check the KGMU website for any updates or changes to the admission process.
*   **Check the Eligibility Criteria:** Before gathering documents, make sure you meet the eligibility criteria for MBBS admission at KGMU, including age, educational qualifications, and NEET (UG) scores.

**How to Find the Official Information:**

1.  **Go to the official KGMU website:** Search for "King George's Medical University" or "KGMU Lucknow" on Google.
2.  **Look for the Admission Section:** Navigate to the "Admissions" or "MBBS Admissions" section of the website.
3.  **Find the Admission Brochure/Notification:** Download the official admission brochure or notification for the relevant admission year. This document will contain all the details about the required documents, eligibility criteria, and the admission process.

entries.question: महिलाओं के स्तन संबंधी समस्याओं का निदान किस डॉक्टर से
entries.answer:
स्तन संबंधी समस्याओं के निदान के लिए, महिलाओं को आमतौर पर इन डॉक्टरों से परामर्श करना चाहिए:

*   **स्तन रोग विशेषज्ञ (Breast specialist):** ये डॉक्टर विशेष रूप से स्तन स्वास्थ्य और स्तन संबंधी बीमारियों के निदान और उपचार में विशेषज्ञ होते हैं।
*   **गाइनेकोलॉजिस्ट (Gynecologist):** स्त्री रोग विशेषज्ञ महिलाओं के प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य और सामान्य स्वास्थ्य की देखभाल करते हैं, जिसमें स्तन स्वास्थ्य भी शामिल है।
*   **सर्जन (Surgeon):** यदि स्तन में गांठ या अन्य समस्या पाई जाती है जिसके लिए सर्जरी की आवश्यकता होती है, तो सर्जन उपचार प्रदान करते हैं।
*   **रेडियोलॉजिस्ट (Radiologist):** ये डॉक्टर इमेजिंग तकनीकों (जैसे मैमोग्राम, अल्ट्रासाउंड, एमआरआई) का उपयोग करके निदान करते हैं।

यदि आपके स्तन में कोई समस्या है, तो आपको सबसे पहले अपने स्त्री रोग विशेषज्ञ या एक स्तन रोग विशेषज्ञ से परामर्श करना चाहिए। वे आपकी स्थिति का आकलन करेंगे और उचित उपचार प्रदान करेंगे।
entries.ai_question_translated_en: महिलाओं के स्तन संबंधी समस्याओं का निदान किस डॉक्टर से
